## Featured Projects

### BookNest
- **Type**: Full-Stack Microservices E-Bookstore
- **Stack**: Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- **Overview**: Split into five independent microservices for books, carts, orders, payments, and users, each with an isolated database model.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/anjanadulan/BookNest
- **Case Study**: https://anjanaww.vercel.app/projects/booknest/

### Distributor Management System
- **Type**: Enterprise Distribution Operations Software
- **Stack**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Lit, Electron, Webpack
- **Overview**: Full-stack operations platform with role-based dashboards, inventory management, order processing, delivery tracking, and PDF export capabilities.
- **Demo**: https://distributor-ms.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/anjanadulan/distributor-ms
- **Case Study**: https://anjanaww.vercel.app/projects/distributor-management-system/

### Smart Aqua Manage Bot
- **Type**: Standalone IoT & Automation Ecosystem
- **Stack**: ESP32, ESP32-CAM, WebSockets, Three.js, Vanilla JS
- **Overview**: Autonomous aquarium hardware ecosystem running local control loops for feeding, water monitoring, cleaning gantries, and real-time 3D web dashboards.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/anjanadulan/Smart-Aqua-Manage-Bot
- **Case Study**: https://anjanaww.vercel.app/projects/smart-aqua-manage-bot/

### AgroChain
- **Type**: Java Desktop Agricultural Supply Chain Application
- **Stack**: Java 24, Swing, MySQL 8, JDBC
- **Overview**: Standalone desktop software managing field crop health, harvest tracking, and direct farmer-to-buyer supply-chain workflows.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/anjanadulan/AgroChain
- **Case Study**: https://anjanaww.vercel.app/projects/agrochain/
